name: the Gilded Bazaar
basis: Vanta's own world of BABEL, from the Mabry Curve roleplay: a living tower of themed floors wearing the skin of an unreleased full-dive game.
summary: The third floor up: a merchant city under a lantern dome that cycles twice in a Concourse day, so its nights are short and it never closes. Spice houses, salons, rooms by the week, fences under the Copper Steps, and a Stair gate one woman owns. BABEL parked its best vendors here; in the tower, everything and everyone has a price.

intensity.voice: pulpy and mythic in a modern frame: omens, weather and System panes, where every win carries a bill and desire is a power with a price

neighborhoods.name: under the lantern dome
neighborhoods.summary: The center of the floor under a dome hung with lanterns that brighten and dim twice in a Concourse day: salons, spice houses, and rooms let by the week.

neighborhoods.name: the spice rows
neighborhoods.summary: Factors' houses and warehouses that smell of clove and pepper, where the floor's money is made and Okonkwo Vale buys his drinks.

neighborhoods.name: the Copper Steps
neighborhoods.summary: A broad flight of copper-shod steps down toward the shaft, with fence rows and paper sellers in the arcades under it, and behind them the toll gate onto the Stair.

neighborhoods.name: the freight wharf
neighborhoods.summary: Cranes and chain-winches on the shaft's edge, where cargo cages load for the floors above and below, and a night crew runs one Sabeen does not own.

places.name: the Lantern Room
places.summary: Sabeen Oro's salon: lamps under colored glass, low divans, hostesses and dancers on a polished floor, and private rooms off it, the Blue Room among them, at the girl's choice and a third to the house. Sabeen prices people the way the Bazaar prices everything, and her guests come to watch her do it.

places.name: the Copper Scale
places.summary: Rooms by the week up three flights: narrow beds with brass frames, a copper basin, one shuttered window on the street. The walls are thin and the neighbors hear everything.

places.name: the spice exchange
places.summary: A hall of factors shouting prices for clove, pepper and things that are not spice, under a board that changes faster than anyone can read it.

places.name: the charm sellers
places.summary: Bazaar charms by grade: copper rings that keep a night from having consequences, hush-beads that muffle words sent over a bond, luck knots. Graded on the ladder, priced to match.

places.name: the fence rows
places.summary: Arcades under the Copper Steps where Pell the Wire and their cousins buy anything, sell anything, and trade in rumor most of all.

places.name: Old Wick's paper
places.summary: A paper seller under the Steps: maps of floors, letters, bills of sale, and the occasional hand-drawn route someone sold to get up the Stair.

places.name: the Stair gate
places.summary: An old iron cage of a toll booth behind the Copper Steps, onto the Stair. Two Talents up. Down is free, because nobody comes back to pay. The gate is Sabeen Oro's, and Pell's cousin keeps it.

places.name: the freight wharf
places.summary: Cranes, winches and cargo cages on the shaft's edge. After dome-dark a night crew loads an unlicensed cage for the floors below, and takes passengers for everything they have.

places.name: the crier's post
places.summary: Where notices go up for the floor and go down the chain to the others: sales, debts, and the Lantern Room's bounties.

places.name: the wharf kitchen
places.summary: A brazier, a pot and a plank bench where crane crews eat between cages, and the night crew eats before.

transit.name: On foot
transit.summary: The dome to the Copper Steps is a quarter hour.

transit.name: Chairmen
transit.summary: Sedan chairs for those who pay not to walk.

careers.name: Salon hostess
careers.summary: Hostessing, dancing and private rooms at a salon, a third to the house.

careers.name: Runner
careers.summary: Fetching people and debts down the Stair for a house.

careers.name: Spice factor
careers.summary: Buying and selling spice and other things on the exchange.

careers.name: Fence
careers.summary: Buying and selling what nobody asks about.

careers.name: Wharf hand
careers.summary: Loading cargo cages on the shaft's edge.

careers.name: Room letter
careers.summary: Letting rooms by the week and hearing through the walls.

career_hubs.name: The trade
career_hubs.summary: Money on the Bazaar is made selling what people want, and people.

climate.summary: Under the lantern dome: warm, fragrant, never dark for long. The dome brightens and dims twice in a Concourse day.

local_color.name: Everything here has a price
local_color.summary: What Sabeen says, and the floor says after her.

local_color.name: Down is free
local_color.summary: Two Talents up, down free at the gate, because nobody comes back to pay.

local_color.name: Two sunsets
local_color.summary: The Bazaar sees two dome-darks for every Concourse night, so a week here is half a week anywhere else.

local_color.name: A third to the house
local_color.summary: The Lantern Room's cut, and the Bazaar's idea of fair.

local_color.name: A copper chit
local_color.summary: A chit stamped with a scale is Sabeen's favor. Keep one long enough and it becomes her debt.

local_color.name: Selling the Turning
local_color.summary: Everybody's selling the Turning this week: any rumor about the new skin goes for good money under the Steps.

prices.item: A week at the Copper Scale
A private room at the Lantern Room
Two seats on the night cage
A floor map from Old Wick

notables.name: Sabeen Oro
notables.about: Keeps the Lantern Room and prices people the way the Bazaar prices everything. Calls everyone darling. Nobody will say whether she is Lilim.
notables.wants: to own whatever is most valuable on the Stair this week

notables.name: Merrow
notables.about: Sabeen's runner, a sharp-faced climber from Salford in a brown coat with a copper scales pin. Owes the house more than she earns.

notables.name: Okonkwo Vale
notables.about: A courteous, married Rank C factor who smells of clove and asks Sabeen for the new ones.

notables.name: Pell the Wire
notables.about: A light-marked rat-line Therian who buys anything and sells everything, rumors first.
notables.wants: the best rumor on the floor

notables.name: Old Wick
notables.about: One-eyed, sells maps and paper, does not haggle with dogs.

notables.name: Nell
notables.about: Up from the Varrow cage trade, quick with gossip.

notables.name: the toll-keeper
notables.about: Pell's cousin, in the iron toll booth behind the Copper Steps.
notables.wants: two Talents from everyone going up

notables.name: the night foreman
notables.about: Runs the night cage down the chains and can smell copper on a passenger.
notables.wants: the chains open and Sabeen out of them
